create_parser_libsvm_ranking: create a LibSVMRankingParser to parse ranking-style LibSVM files into per-query labeled feature tuples
parse_libsvm_lines: parse LibSVM-formatted ranking lines with feature index-to-name mapping and custom label, query_id, and doc_id names
combine_libsvm_features: combine parsed LibSVM ranking features into a single stacked float_features array per query
handle_libsvm_parser_errors: handle LibSVM parsing errors with line number, line content, and descriptive reason messages
iterate_ranking_examples: iterate over parsed ranking examples yielding query-identifier and numpy feature mapping tuples
